reason: The initial cumulative reservation guard stopped before completing the lower bracket despite actual standard-price usage of about $1.33.
new_guard: For completed requests retain 2x their observed standard-price token cost. For unsettled requests retain full maximum reservation. Add the full next reservation before deciding whether to send.
unchanged: No automatic retries; original per-request ledger preserved; unknown requests never refunded.
additional_depth4_group: After the predefined depth5/6 downward expansion, measure one five-item depth4 group twice to anchor the transition, because 5/6/7 scores are noisy and high-depth cells have >20% invalid responses. Same frozen reserve pool and chosen recipe; no selection by individual item outcome.
